title: Influence bound for monotone functions
statement: For every $n\ge 0$ and every coordinatewise monotone sign-valued Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, the total influence of its real-valued version is at most the total influence of majority on that cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
